card.name: Space before edition number in citations
card.fires_on: The space right after a textbook title at the end of a reference citation, just before the edition number such as 18th ed. Mostly in medical textbook references.

modes.label: Space before edition
modes.description: The blank after a textbook title and period, where an edition number like 7th ed comes next.

modes.label: Hyphen in chemical name
modes.description: A rare case: a hyphen inside a long chemical name.
